searchText: I'm guessing that the BLS specification is going to be postponed indefinitely due to the Coronavirus. **vbuterin** If it gets postponed too long I'm going to push that we just talk to filecoin and agree on a spec with them (as they want to launch soon too) and screw everyone else sounds good to me! **vbuterin** If the eventual spec ends up changing then we could consider changing to it in phase 1 **vbuterin** but maybe us and filecoin agreeing would be enough to strong arm the spec into not changing more... 😜 **dannyryan** Yeah, agreed No rush to deploy deposit contract, but lets plan on _not_ letting the ietf spec be the last bottleneck for launch **vbuterin** Does the deposit contract depend on the ietf spec? **vbuterin** Aaah I guess it does **vbuterin** because the deposit includes a signature **dannyryan** Yup **vbuterin** So the contract does not depend, but what people have to send into it does **dannyryan** Yes **dannyryan** But if we launch mainnet contract, then presumbaly people will send **vbuterin** right **vbuterin** Are there any blockers left re deposit contract btw? **vbuterin** Or is it just a "we can release whenever ready" thing? **dannyryan** There are some independent audits of the FV going on but its a release whenever thing imo Networking call this Wednesday -- https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/137 Major goal is to discuss the challenges in the attestation aggregation/subnet strategy. Other than v0.11 conformance, this is one of the major blockers for mc-testnets, and after having some discussions with teams, there are a number of edge-cases and issue to work through. We'll do a bit of knowledge sharing, discussion, and assess if anything in the spec can/should be tweaked to simplify things Eth2 call this Thurdsay -- https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/135 General structure, plus we'll spend some time discussing the coming mc-testnets

excerpts.content: I'm guessing that the BLS specification is going to be postponed indefinitely due to the Coronavirus.

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**vbuterin**
If it gets postponed too long I'm going to push that we just talk to filecoin and agree on a spec with them (as they want to launch soon too) and screw everyone else

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**vbuterin**
If the eventual spec ends up changing then we could consider changing to it in phase 1

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**vbuterin**
but maybe us and filecoin agreeing would be enough to strong arm the spec into not changing more... 😜

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**dannyryan**
Yeah, agreed

No rush to deploy deposit contract, but lets plan on _not_ letting the ietf spec be the last bottleneck for launch

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**vbuterin**
Does the deposit contract depend on the ietf spec?

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**vbuterin**
because the deposit includes a signature

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**vbuterin**
So the contract does not depend, but what people have to send into it does

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**dannyryan**
But if we launch mainnet contract, then presumbaly people will send

excerpts.content:
**vbuterin**
Are there any blockers left re deposit contract btw?

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**vbuterin**
Or is it just a "we can release whenever ready" thing?

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**dannyryan**
There are some independent audits of the FV going on but its a release whenever thing imo

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
Networking call this Wednesday -- https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/137
Major goal is to discuss the challenges in the attestation aggregation/subnet strategy. Other than v0.11 conformance, this is one of the major blockers for mc-testnets, and after having some discussions with teams, there are a number of edge-cases and issue to work through. We'll do a bit of knowledge sharing, discussion, and assess if anything in the spec can/should be tweaked to simplify things

Eth2 call this Thurdsay -- https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/135
General structure, plus we'll spend some time discussing the coming mc-testnets
